description:

name: The_Secure_Crumpet
description:
Let's be real, you probably don't want your vial inventory on full display in your fridge. 
These custom inserts for the Extra Small Toolpro case provide serious containment and privacy.

Holds 110 3ml vials across two tiers, with extra open storage on the bottom tray to hold BAC water, pens, or small packets of whipped butter for your crumpets.

If you would like different layouts for the case, let me know and we can work it out!

NOTE: This is for the Inserts only, Case is NOT included

name: Novopen_4_Spacers
description:
NovoPen 4 Spacers [10-Pack]
Precision printed specifically for the NovoPen 4. 
Will they fit other NovoPen models? That is a mystery we leave to the bravest among you to solve. 

Because these little rings are delicate and practically beg to be dropped into the void of your carpet, they come in a mandatory 10-pack. Consider the extra nine as your built-in backup plan.

name: Pen_Storage_9
description:
The 9 Pen Silo
Got your insulin pens rolling around the fridge drawer like a disorganised pharmacy? 
Not anymore. This heavy-duty storage cylinder corrals the chaos and locks them down vertically so they are always ready to deploy.

It features a fully threaded screw-on lid, meaning your stash stays completely secure even if this thing takes a tumble off the counter or bounces around in a travel bag.
